items.notes: Cross-checks: HSG Laser 宏石 prospectus — fibre laser cutter average 52.71万 (2021), 45.11万 (2022), 37.21万 (H1 2023), all powers, as tabulated in Senfeng 森峰's IPO inquiry reply (https://qxb-pdf-osscache.qixin.com/AnBaseinfo/7442124a0194ffd19a35b219bc2aee83.pdf); Senfeng 38.24 / 35.38 / 35.63万 same years; Bodor 2019 ASP ≈43万 (carried, old). Book now (UK sourced capex £374,700 × 0.55 × 8.88) ≈ 1,830,000 CNY — about 4.9× this 2025 domestic ASP; the book figure is a Trumpf-class price, not a domestic 6 kW machine.
